narrowings.rationale: Compute supplies no identity/tenant/application/environment context, so a conforming host skips the contribution (protocol composeUi does the same).
Compute caps links at 64 (host resource policy).

Navigation order is kept as an i64 for sorting; 1e21 is integral in ECMAScript but outside i64. JSON.stringify never writes an i64-range integer this way.
serde_json reads 20.0 as a float and order is an i64. JSON.stringify writes integral numbers without a fraction, so AppPort producers never send this.
Same: exponent notation is read as a float; JSON.stringify writes 20.
Same: -0 is read as a float; JSON.stringify writes 0.
serde_json refuses numbers beyond f64 range (1e400), which JSON.stringify cannot produce (it writes null for Infinity).
A UTF-8 JSON parser cannot hold a lone UTF-16 surrogate (representation limit).
